units.passage: For lower division courses where AI use is discouraged, the committee recommended changes to assignments and assessment practices, where necessary:
units.why: For lower-division courses "where AI use is discouraged", AI is discouraged but the scenario is not a formal ban (P03).

units.passage: Khoury College encourages less — and potentially zero — AI use in introductory courses
units.why: "Khoury College encourages less — and potentially zero — AI use in introductory courses" is a college steer toward little or no AI in intro courses without a ban; P03.
units.fit_note: Applies to introductory courses and is an encouragement to instructors, not a ban. / Also a stance (less or zero AI in intro courses); it is a college principle in a news item, not a formal rule.

units.passage: Because the development and mastery of advanced academic skills is expected not only during the degree program but throughout the scholar’s subsequent professional career, the primary responsibility of authorship resides with the student. For these reasons, over-reliance (as deﬁned by the academic discipline and the program or advisory committee faculty) on generative AI is strongly discouraged.
units.why: "over-reliance ... on generative AI is strongly discouraged" discourages without forbidding; the limit is defined by discipline and committee. P03.

units.passage: Our course helps you develop two key skills as a historian: research and writing. AI is not a productive technology to use in the research process for our course.
units.why: The sample policy states "AI is not a productive technology to use in the research process for our course", discouraging AI for one skill without a formal ban, so P03; it is an example the guide models for instructors.
units.fit_note: Sample course policy text embedded in the guidance, not a university rule.

units.passage: While AI can certainly be helpful for University business and academics, the use of AI by students to assist with assignments and/or tests is not ideal.
units.why: Says student AI use on assignments or tests 'is not ideal': discouraged but not banned, so P03.

units.passage: It is a bad -- in fact, downright terrible -- idea to use AI to do the readings.
units.policy: It is a bad -- in fact, downright terrible -- idea to use AI to do the readings.
units.why: Strongly discourages using AI to do the readings: not formally forbidden ('idea'), so P03.

units.passage: The easiest way to ensure that your writing does not come under suspicion for AI use is to not use AI.
units.why: "The easiest way to ensure that your writing does not come under suspicion for AI use is to not use AI" advises students against AI use without itself stating the ban (the "comprehensive policy" follows), so it discourages AI use (P03), not a "ask first" rule.
units.fit_note: A: Advises not using AI to avoid suspicion; no question-asking is involved. B: Practical advice to avoid suspicion.

units.passage: You are discouraged from using generative AI tools except when instructed to do so
units.policy: Students are discouraged from using generative AI tools except when instructed to do so.
units.why: 'You are discouraged from using generative AI tools except when instructed to do so' discourages without a flat ban (P03).

units.passage: When you use AI at UCCS, we hope you use it to support and enhance your education—not as a shortcut that will interfere with your learning.
units.policy: We hope you use AI at UCCS to support and enhance your education, not as a shortcut that will interfere with your learning.
units.why: The page hopes students use AI "to support and enhance your education" and "not as a shortcut that will interfere with your learning"; this discourages shortcut use without forbidding it, which is P03. The explanation of why shortcuts hurt is the next sentence (P41).

units.passage: Accordingly, the use of generative artificial intelligence (AI) tools is generally discouraged in this course, but will be permitted for select assignments.
units.why: The AS-UA sample says use 'is generally discouraged in this course, but will be permitted for select assignments'. Discouraged but not forbidden, so P03.

units.passage: If you cannot guarantee that the information you include in your research and/or knowledge product can be properly cited and sources, then we do not recommend using an AI tool for your research.
units.policy: If you cannot guarantee that the information included in your research can be properly cited and sourced, the library does not recommend using an AI tool for your research.
units.why: The guide says 'we do not recommend using an AI tool for your research' where information cannot be properly cited and sourced; it discourages without forbidding, so P03, should-not, restrict.

units.passage: While I would prefer you not use these tools and instead commit to the productive struggle that is learning, I recognize that these tools are not going away.
units.policy: The instructor would prefer students not use these tools and commit to the productive struggle of learning, but does not ban them.
units.why: Goodman says "I would prefer you not use these tools and instead commit to the productive struggle that is learning" but does not ban them, so AI is discouraged, not forbidden (P03).

units.passage: 1. You are discouraged from using AI tools UNLESS under direct instruction from your instructor to do so.
units.why: "You are discouraged from using AI tools UNLESS under direct instruction" discourages AI without forbidding it: P03.

units.passage: using a search engine uses far less energy than using a chatbot and will almost certainly provide more accurate results
units.why: Says a search engine 'uses far less energy than using a chatbot and will almost certainly provide more accurate results'; discourages chatbot use for plain search without forbidding it, P03.

units.passage: Students should avoid using AI tools for scholarship applications, both in essays and for completion of the application form
units.why: 'Students should avoid using AI tools for scholarship applications'; discourages non-course AI use, P03.

units.passage: Unless explicitly instructed otherwise, avoid using AI tools for scholarship applications, including essays or the completion of the application
units.why: 'avoid using AI tools for scholarship applications' unless instructed otherwise; discouragement, P03.

units.passage: Reliance on generative AI tools for a significant part of the assignment.
units.why: Yellow light: 'Reliance on generative AI tools for a significant part of the assignment' marks heavy reliance as risky, short of banned (P03).

units.passage: You use generative AI for a lot of the development of an assignment.
units.why: Yellow light: 'You use generative AI for a lot of the development of an assignment' marks heavy use as risky (P03).

units.passage: Also, consider whether generative AI tools might really be the most appropriate tool given your own goals and situation.
units.why: Nudges students to question whether AI is the right tool, a mild discouragement without a ban (P03).

units.passage: just because you are permitted to use AI doesn’t mean it is the best tool for the job.
units.why: Cautions that permitted use is not always appropriate use, a mild discouragement (P03).

units.passage: You will not need to use artificial intelligence (AI) tools such as ChatGPT for any of the assignments.
units.policy: Students will not need to use AI tools such as ChatGPT for any of the assignments.
units.why: 'You will not need to use artificial intelligence (AI) tools such as ChatGPT for any of the assignments' tells students AI is unnecessary and is not a ban; the same template goes on to allow use with citation. That is discouragement without forbidding (P03), so it is not P01. 'Will not need' is a statement of fact, so modality is informs; unit_stance is restrict because it steers students away fro

units.passage: Students are encouraged to use student academic support services available at Kean to develop their skills and avoid reliance on Generative AI tools.
units.why: "Students are encouraged to use student academic support services ... to avoid reliance on Generative AI tools" advises students on how to work without leaning on AI, discouraging reliance without a ban, so student, during-work, should, P03.

units.passage: At the same time, critical engagement discourages GAI use on tasks for which GAI is not designed or for which users cannot easily verify outputs (e.g., retrieval of information or making judgments based on experience).
units.why: The Scope section sets an orientation of "critical engagement" that discourages AI for tasks whose outputs cannot be easily verified; this is discouragement short of a ban, so P03, chosen over P02 because the discouraging half is the distinctive rule.

units.passage: students have a shared culture that values and fosters residential learning and discourages excessive reliance on AI.
units.why: a culture that 'discourages excessive reliance on AI' expresses discouragement without a ban (P03).

units.passage: (Please adapt as needed for your subject) The Use of Generative AI Is Prohibited in the Subject + Since a central goal of this subject is to help you become independent and critical thinkers, you are discouraged from using AI tools to create [SPECIFY: TEXT | CODE | EQUATIONS | VIDEO | AUDIO | IMAGES] in your work (assignments, activities, responses, etc).
units.policy: Students are discouraged from using AI tools to create text, code, equations, video, audio or images in their work.
units.why: The template says 'you are discouraged from using AI tools to create' text, code and so on; discouraged but not forbidden is P03.

units.passage: Since a central goal of this subject is to help you become independent and critical thinkers, you are discouraged from using AI tools to create [SPECIFY: TEXT | CODE | EQUATIONS | VIDEO | AUDIO | IMAGES] in your work (assignments, activities, responses, etc). Any work submitted using AI tools will be treated as though it was plagiarized. If any part of this is confusing or uncertain, please reach out to me for a conversation before submitting your work. Adapted from the Center for Teaching Excellence, BC Limited Use of Generative AI Is Permitted with Proper Citation + Example 1 : Since a central goal of this subject is to help you become independent and critical thinkers, you are discouraged from the extensive use of generative AI tools to create (SPECIFY: TEXT | CODE | EQUATIONS | VIDEO | AUDIO | IMAGES) as part of your work.
units.policy: Students are discouraged from the extensive use of generative AI tools to create text, code, equations, video, audio or images.
units.why: Example 1 says students 'are discouraged from the extensive use of generative AI tools'; limited use is permitted, extensive use discouraged (P03).

units.passage: “Use of generative AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, DALL·E, etc.) is permitted only with prior instructor approval. If you wish to use these tools to brainstorm ideas, locate sources, generate content, or get feedback, please consult with me first. Unauthorized use may be considered a violation of academic honesty.” Use of GenAI Tools Discouraged. Use this if your course prioritizes original writing, reasoning, or data analysis that should be unaided. “Use of generative AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini) is discouraged for any assignment or activity in this course.
units.why: The 'Discouraged' template says AI 'is discouraged for any assignment or activity', which P03 covers; its other sentences carry the actual rules, coded separately.
units.fit_note: Labelled discouraged, but the next sentences make use a violation, so the template acts as a ban. The following sentence in the same template makes use a violation, so it is more than discouragement.

units.passage: while I would prefer you not use these tools to complete the written assignments for this course
units.why: The instructor says they 'would prefer you not use these tools' for written assignments, discouraging without banning (P03).

units.passage: In most cases, AI writing tools should not be used as an academic source of information.
units.why: 'In most cases, AI writing tools should not be used as an academic source of information' discourages AI as a source without banning it, P03.
units.fit_note: Also says to cite the original sources the tool lists.

units.passage: This is not recommended as it doesn’t play to the strengths of current AI systems.
units.why: Market research 'is not recommended' with AI; P03 (discourage without forbidding) fits.

units.passage: Outside of those circumstances, you are discouraged from using AI tools to generate content (text, video, audio, images) that will end up in any student work (assignments, activities, responses, etc) that is part of your evaluation in this course.
units.policy: Outside the activities that call for AI, students are discouraged from using AI tools to generate content (text, video, audio, images) that ends up in work that is evaluated.
units.why: 'You are discouraged from using AI tools to generate content ... that will end up in any student work' discourages AI without forbidding it, so P03.

units.passage: Students are urged to be cautious when using any web tools designed to assist with assignments without their instructors’ explicit permission to do so and to cite their sources in all their work.
units.why: "Students are urged to be cautious when using any web tools designed to assist with assignments without their instructors' explicit permission" advises care and ties use to instructor permission. It does not ban, so it is closest to P03 (discourage without forbidding); P04 is not chosen because no per-instructor decision procedure is set.
units.fit_note: Also makes instructors' explicit permission the condition for using such web tools; it does not name AI explicitly.

units.passage: The CFD does not endorse the use of AI tools exclusively for student work or to circumvent the actual student learning process. The ethical use of AICGTs must always be considered.
units.why: 'The CFD does not endorse the use of AI tools exclusively for student work or to circumvent the actual student learning process' discourages relying on AI for student work without forbidding it, which is P03.

units.passage: While there are phenomenal prospects for the use of AI to assist in almost any field, students should be cautious about the use of AI for academic work.
units.why: "students should be cautious about the use of AI for academic work" discourages AI use without banning it (P03).

units.passage: While ChatGPT presents valuable opportunities for supplementing traditional teaching methods, it should be used selectively and thoughtfully.
units.why: The limited sample says ChatGPT 'should be used selectively and thoughtfully', a soft norm to restrict use. P03 (discourage without forbidding) is chosen over P04 because it is a general cautious norm, not a decision about who sets the rule.
units.fit_note: Selective use is recommended as permitted in limited form; it is not framed as discouraging AI outright.

units.passage: Instructors should avoid use of GenAI, whether by instructor or students, when it might undermine learning outcomes or misrepresent students’ abilities.
units.why: "Instructors should avoid use of GenAI... when it might undermine learning outcomes or misrepresent students’ abilities" discourages AI where it harms learning without prohibiting it, so P03.
units.fit_note: Also concerns misrepresenting students' abilities and covers instructor use.

units.passage: use AI deliberately rather than reflexively, weighing the resource cost of a given use against the benefit it provides, and should prefer simpler, less resource-intensive means when appropriate.
units.policy: Members of our community should use AI deliberately rather than reflexively, weighing the resource cost of a given use against the benefit it provides, and should prefer simpler, less resource-intensive means when appropriate
units.why: "use AI deliberately rather than reflexively" and "prefer simpler, less resource-intensive means" discourages casual AI use without forbidding it: P03.
units.fit_note: Discourages reflexive use for environmental reasons; P03 captures the discouragement but not the resource-cost reason.

units.passage: The use of generative AI tools is only permitted within given parameters. In alignment with the USF Honor Code , students must present work that is authentically their own. In this course, the use of generative AI tools is only permitted within the parameters provided by the instructor, specific to each assignment, with appropriate attribution. As this policy may be different from other course AI policies, please ask your instructor to clarify any questions you may have. To mitigate risks associated with the use of generative AI, please review the Guidelines for Responsible Use of Artificial Intelligence (AI) at USF . The use of generative AI tools is strongly discouraged or not permitted unless explicitly stated by the instructor.
units.policy: Use of generative AI tools is strongly discouraged unless explicitly stated by the instructor.
units.why: Option 3 says use is 'strongly discouraged' in one form of the statement, discouraging without a formal ban (P03).
units.fit_note: Template offers 'strongly discouraged' or 'not permitted' as alternative wordings.

units.passage: you are discouraged from using AI tools to generate content
units.why: Sample (Colorado): outside designated tasks students "are discouraged from using AI tools to generate content"; discouraged not forbidden, P03.

units.passage: For Group Activities, the use of generative AI is strongly discouraged
units.why: "For Group Activities, the use of generative AI is strongly discouraged" discourages without forbidding, P03.

units.passage: Some AI services (such as DeepSeek) are developed and operated in foreign jurisdictions where data privacy laws, government access rights, and data retention practices differ significantly from U.S. standards. USU discourages the use of such services for university work. If you believe a specific service is necessary for your work, you are expected to work with the relevant governing unit to evaluate it before use
units.why: 'USU discourages the use of such services for university work' about foreign-based AI like DeepSeek: discouraged but not forbidden, P03, though the rule concerns tool origin and not learning.
units.fit_note: Concerns foreign-jurisdiction AI services for university work, with a pre-use evaluation expected if necessary.

units.passage: Students are strongly discouraged from misusing unauthorized online sources including generative artificial intelligence outlets.
units.why: 'Students are strongly discouraged from misusing unauthorized online sources including generative artificial intelligence outlets' discourages without forbidding, P03.
